source.label: FY27 production database · read-only snapshot
filters: FY27; 20 currently active student accounts; excludes system accounts, teachers and admins
Positive activity/eligible historical award/Word Lab entries only; excludes login, streak, achievements, corrections and course-map recovery
caveats: Rewarded practice is a lower bound on use, not visits or enjoyment. Award limits and historical tracking changes can hide repeat practice.
Distinct student + activity + New York date prevents multiple awards on one day from inflating return counts.
Activities have unequal availability and may be assigned or featured. Curriculum-driven returns are not proof of preference.
No activity feedback was submitted by these FY27 students in the period.

metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct current students with eligible awards for the same activity on at least two New York calendar dates.

metricDefinitions.label: Student-days
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct student/activity/date combinations, summed within each activity.

evidenceFlow.title: Read-only extraction
evidenceFlow.detail: Prisma transaction with SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY; selected FY27 enrollments with role=student and isSystemAccount=false; retrieved bounded ledger, progress, activity metadata, assignments and feedback. Snapshot 2026-11-11T20:05:19.556Z.

evidenceFlow.title: Aggregation
evidenceFlow.detail: Filter current active cohort. Map grammar-exercise slugs to guide titles; merge reward variants by activity title; count distinct students and local dates. Exclude non-practice rewards and backfills. Anonymized query and analysis scripts retained with this report.
